description: 都市ガス使用量 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 日進市. 平成23年度から平成28年度までの都市ガス使用量データです。. Coverage: 日進市. The portal files it under the publisher 日進市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
